description: Source code for Wi-Fi radio temperature statistics collection and processing, including functions for generating keys, validating arguments, executing stats API, and copying stats from cache.

methods.name: validate_radio_temperature_args
methods.description: Validates radio temperature arguments, checks for NULL and valid radio index.

methods.name: generate_radio_temperature_clctr_stats_key
methods.description: Generates a key string for radio temperature collector stats based on args.

methods.name: generate_radio_temperature_provider_stats_key
methods.description: Generates a key string for radio temperature provider stats based on config.

methods.name: process_radio_temperature_stats
methods.description: Processes radio temperature data, allocates memory, and validates temperature value.

methods.name: execute_radio_temperature_stats_api
methods.description: Main API to collect radio temperature, update data, and send events if subscribed.

methods.name: copy_radio_temperature_stats_from_cache
methods.description: Copies radio temperature stats from cache into provided stats pointer.
